title: What Loads Dust Into HVAC Returns Near Loudoun
headline: New-build gypsum, Leesburg basements, and why Ashburn returns fill faster than they should
description: Loudoun County mixes historic Leesburg with active HOA construction in Ashburn and Brambleton. An educational look at why ducts hold drywall dust and pollen, and when to clean them.

sections.heading: New construction is not a clean HVAC system
paragraphs: Builders run the air handler to dry mud and keep crews comfortable. That air is full of fines. They settle in the trunks. You move in, change a filter, and still get dusty registers. The dust was already downstream of the filter.
If you moved into a Loudoun house in the last few years and the air still feels like a job site, when you are ready to book, use the [Loudoun County location page](/locations/loudoun).

sections.heading: Typical signs in Leesburg and Ashburn
listItems: White or gray film on supplies in a house less than ten years old.
Musty Leesburg basement air when the AC starts.
Long dry times in a three-story townhome dryer closet.

sections.heading: Loudoun is two indoor-air problems sharing one county
paragraphs: Leesburg has older houses, damp basements, and trunks that were added after the house was built. Ashburn, Broadlands, Brambleton, and South Riding still have sections going up. Construction dust does not stay on the next lot. Returns on an occupied street pull gypsum and insulation fibers for years if the system was never cleaned after the builder left.
Pollen is the third load. Loudoun’s remaining canopy and every HOA street tree dump it onto decks each spring. Filters catch some of it. Ducts store the rest.

sections.heading: Keeping trunks and dryer runs healthier between cleanings
paragraphs: Loudoun jobs are scheduled from our metro offices. This article is educational — use the [location page](/locations/loudoun) when you are ready to book.
Loudoun is served from our [Burke](/locations/burke) office. The drive is honest. [McLean](/locations/mclean) and [Fairfax](/locations/fairfax) are closer-in pages on the same crew.
Service details live on the [Loudoun location page](/locations/loudoun). Add [dryer vent cleaning](/dryer-vent-cleaning) for stacked townhomes.
listItems: Ask for a duct cleaning after you close on a new build, not five years later.
Keep indoor humidity under 50% in Leesburg basements.
Clear dryer vents about once a year in Ashburn and Brambleton.

faq.q: Is this a sales page for Loudoun duct cleaning?
faq.a: No. This post explains mechanisms and signs. Service details live on the Loudoun location page.

faq.q: What usually causes gray film on supply registers?
faq.a: Fine particles that bypass or overload filters settle in cool trunks and recirculate when the blower runs.

faq.q: When is dryer vent cleaning the better first step?
faq.a: When laundry closets stay hot, dry times double, or you smell burnt lint — clear the vent to the exterior cap.
